'''Rapid Repetition Defense Measures''', or '''RRDM''', were [[Computer/Legends|computer]] programs used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They constantly scanned Imperial computer systems looking for alien and intrusive programming that was counter to the established norms of the host computer.
